title: introduce regional_shedder_reconciler and fix stuck circuit recovery hotfix
author: Priya Shah
release_notes: Fixes a class of incidents where regional circuit breakers could remain stuck open after transient overloads; adds reconciler to ensure circuit state convergence and reduces SLO enforcement oscillation via hysteresis/backoff. Non-breaking runtime hotfix.
description: Summary: Add a new regional_shedder_reconciler component to the runtime control loop and apply a hotfix that prevents circuits from remaining stuck open after a failed eviction path. Motivation: We observed multiple incidents (ENG-1849) where transient overload + missing eviction timestamp left regional circuit state in a permanently open state, causing prolonged downstream failures and customer-impacting SLO breaches. This PR implements a lightweight reconciliation loop that observes per-region SLO signals and circuit heartbeats, repairs inconsistent states, and applies a conservative exponential backoff window to prevent oscillation. It also includes a targeted hotfix for the eviction path where a nil timestamp could short-circuit a circuit reset, which produced the stuck circuits. Changes (high level): - runtime/eviction/reconciler.go: new reconciler + reconciliation policy and backoff state machine. - runtime/eviction/reconciler_test.go: unit tests covering divergent state, heartbeat expiry, and backoff decay. - controlplane/slo/manager.go: expose compact SLO convergence summary for reconciler polling. - controlplane/slo/metrics_sync.go: add events for circuit_reconciler.actions and circuit_reconciler.errors. - observability/alerts.yaml: new alert slo.reconciler.stuck_circuits and adjusted threshold for existing slo.breach.alert to reduce duplicates. - deploy/helm/templates/reconciler.yaml: small deployment manifest to enable reconciler in Dedicated and Private modes. - runtime/eviction/evict_path.go: hotfix that guards missing eviction timestamps and forces a soft-reset marker so reconciler can detect and repair. Commits: - 1c9f8a4: initial reconciler implementation and reconciliation policy (runtime/eviction/*). - 3b2e7d1: add metrics/events and telemetry hooks (controlplane/slo/metrics_sync.go, observability/alerts.yaml). - 7f4a0d2: hotfix guard for missing eviction timestamp and additional unit tests; bump helm chart (deploy/helm/templates/reconciler.yaml). Tests and CI: First CI run reported a flaky test in reconciler_test.go (timeout in TestBackoffDecay) and a lint failure in controlplane/slo/manager.go (unused var). I addressed the flaky test by reducing time-based sleeps and replacing with a deterministic fake clock; I fixed lint by removing the unused var and adding a comment. Rerun CI: all checks passed (unit, integration, lint, e2e smoke on Dedicated). Review conversation summary: - Ethan Moore (requested changes): pointed out that naive reconcilers can create negative interactions with autoscaler; requested explicit opt-in via helm value and a safety limit on reconcile rate. Response: added a helm value reconciler.enabled (default false for Private minimal installs) and a reconcile_rate_limit setting; documented behavior in deploy/helm/values.yaml and reconciler.go. - Liang Chen (requested improvements): asked for clearer telemetry for action vs no-op reconciles and suggested adding a metric for reconciler_repaired_circuits_total with tags. Response: exposed reconciler_repaired_circuits_total and detailed action reasons in events; added tests asserting metric increments. - Marissa O'Neil (approval after changes): asked for a runtime-config toggle to disable exponential backoff for customers doing deterministic failover tests; added reconciler.backoff_disabled via config file and documented in runtime/README. Author notes: kept the reconciler conservative by default (no automatic enabling in small Dedicated clusters) and added an opt-in path in Console and Helm. Deployment and rollout plan: - Start rollout to canary Dedicated region with reconciler.enabled=true and reconcile_rate_limit=1/minute for 24h with tight telemetry watch. - If stable, increase to 5/minute and enable in additional regions; Private customers can opt-in via installer flag. Operational runbook (added to docs/runbooks/reconciler.md): - How to detect stuck circuits (metric patterns), how to temporarily disable reconciler, how to force a manual reconcile, and rollback path. Impact and rationale: This PR reduces mean time to recover from transient overloads by ensuring the control plane and runtime have a convergent view of circuit state. The conservative defaults and rate limits reduce risk of oscillation with autoscaling. Backwards compatibility: No API changes; feature is opt-in in most installs and toggles are available via helm and runtime config. Merge outcome: Squash merged after approvals from Liang and Marissa and CI green. Related work: follow-ups planned: - ENG-1912: console UI for reconciler status per region - ENG-1950: add reconciliation proofs to audit log for compliance tracking.
